c512a86e0fd6df71.description: About the Role of Sales Manager Toys Brand Trading Company, a wholesale specialist in toys and baby products, is seeking an experienced Sales Manager. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves leading the sales team, developing strategic sales plans, expanding the customer base, and driving overall sales and revenue growth for the company. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement sales plans, set sales targets, and monitor performance to ensure target achievement. Lead, manage, and evaluate the sales team, focusing on skill development and capability enhancement. Organize and supervise field visits for sales representatives, regularly monitoring and evaluating their results. Acquire new customers, reactivate existing accounts, and build strong relationships with key clients. Monitor product movement and inventory levels at customer locations to increase order volumes and encourage repeat purchases. Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify new business opportunities. Coordinate with Marketing, Finance, and Warehouse departments to ensure efficient sales operations, collections, and product availability. Prepare periodic sales reports, analyze performance results, and provide recommendations for sales performance improvement. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 7 years of sales experience, including at least 2 years in sales management or leading sales teams. Experience in wholesale sales, with a preference for backgrounds in baby products or consumer goods. Demonstrated experience in dealing with retail chains and key accounts. Proven track record of achieving sales targets, increasing revenue, and acquiring new customers. Key Skills Strong leadership and negotiation skills. Proficiency in sales team management and field supervision. Ability to analyze sales data, develop comprehensive sales plans, and prepare detailed performance reports. c56a54d41e9f3ce0.description: About the Role CEER is seeking an Assistant Manager Aftersales Field Force to lead field operations across Saudi Arabian markets. This full-time role is based in Riyadh and focuses on ensuring consistent execution of aftersales standards, operational excellence, and customer experience across all service locations. The position involves driving dealer and branch performance while achieving customer, operational, and financial objectives. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to lead the field operations function, ensuring high standards in aftersales. This includes maintaining operational excellence and a strong customer experience across all service locations. The Assistant Manager will be responsible for enhancing dealer and branch performance through structured governance, capability development, operational audits, and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation and coordination of field operations activities across dealer and company-owned service locations. Ensure alignment with aftersales objectives, operational guidelines, and network performance targets. Track dealer and branch performance using structured KPI management, including CSI, FRFT, productivity, throughput, retention, revenue, and profitability metrics. Conduct regular operational assessments and field audits to ensure compliance with aftersales standards, policies, procedures, and customer experience requirements. Identify performance gaps and develop corrective action plans in collaboration with service managers and dealer leadership teams. Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs to enhance efficiency, service quality, and customer satisfaction. Support dealer capability development through coaching, mentoring, training needs identification, and performance improvement initiatives. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to lead field operations and manage performance across multiple locations. Experience in developing and implementing operational standards and improvement initiatives. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves leading field operations across various markets within KSA, requiring a focus on consistent execution and performance management. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

c59f7c4985846ec6.company_name: مؤسسة عماد ابراهيم الفت حلواني لتقديم الوجبات
c59f7c4985846ec6.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة عماد ابراهيم الفت حلواني لتقديم الوجبات عن معد وجبات سريعة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد وطهي مجموعة متنوعة من الأطعمة، بما في ذلك الوجبات السريعة والشطائر والمرطبات، مع الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحضير الأطعمة والوجبات للزوار وفقًا لقائمة الأطعمة المخصصة. استخدام أدوات المطبخ المختلفة مثل الشوايات والمقالي العميقة وغيرها بفعالية وأمان. اتباع جميع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة العامة والنظافة. متابعة صيانة وإصلاح جميع المعدات المستخدمة في عمليات التحضير والتجهيز. توفير المكونات اللازمة لتحضير الوجبات بشكل مستمر. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إعداد الأطعمة أو ما شابه. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة للعمل بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، ضمن فريق يسعى لتقديم وجبات عالية الجودة للعملاء.

c5e98cca152c721a.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking an Officer Loss Prevention to join their team in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for maintaining a secure environment for guests and employees, protecting company assets, and responding to various incidents across the property. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Patrol all areas of the property and assist guests with room access. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions (CCTV), perimeter alarm systems, duress alarms, and fire life safety systems. Lock property entrances as required and conduct daily physical hazard inspections. Respond to accidents, administer first aid/CPR as needed, and contact emergency medical services (EMS). Assist guests and employees during emergency situations and notify appropriate individuals of incidents. Defuse guest and employee disturbances, calling for outside assistance if necessary. Complete incident reports for all Security/Loss Prevention related events and handle interruptions and complaints. Resolve safety hazard situations and escort unwelcome persons from the property without disrupting operations. Respond to scenes of vehicle accidents/thefts and call for assistance using proper code responses. Complete a Loss Prevention shift summary/daily activity report. Maintain confidentiality of all Security/Loss Prevention and property reports/documents, releasing information only to authorized individuals. Conduct investigations, gather evidence, and interview relevant parties. Operational Compliance and Professional Standards Adhere to all company policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Complete required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards, anticipating and addressing service needs. Assist individuals with disabilities and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Communicate clearly and professionally, preparing and reviewing written documents accurately. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues and support team goals. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Read and visually verify information in various formats (*, small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines to identify defects. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point-of-sale systems. Move at a speed required to respond to work situations (*, run, walk, jog). Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance and objects exceeding 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Navigate sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, as well as stairs and service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Ability to perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia, within the hospitality sector. The role involves working in a dynamic environment that requires constant vigilance and responsiveness to ensure safety and security.

c5f0d93e2eaa37e1.description: About the Role Edition is seeking a Pastry Commis to join their team in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves preparing a variety of baked goods and pastries, ensuring high standards of quality and presentation. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience in a pastry or baking environment. Key Responsibilities Prepare breads and pastries, including doughs, fillings, proofing, baking, and decorating as required. Review production sheets to understand daily baked goods requirements. Cook and prepare food items according to established recipes, quality, and presentation standards, adhering to food preparation checklists. Maintain kitchen logs to ensure compliance with food safety programs. Inform the Chef of excess food items for daily special planning. Safely and appropriately use baking and measuring tools, equipment, and appliances. Follow and ensure compliance with food safety handling policies and procedures, including personal hygiene. Check and ensure correct temperatures of kitchen appliances and food, reporting any issues to management. Monitor the quality of food prepared and portions served throughout the shift. Operational Support and Compliance Assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees, serving as a role model. Adhere to all company policies and procedures, including safety and security protocols; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Communicate professionally and clearly, answering telephones with appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships and support the team in achieving common goals. Handle sensitive issues with tact, respect, and confidentiality. Comply with all quality expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Capability to move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a pastry or baking role. Demonstrated ability to prepare a variety of breads and pastries. Knowledge of food safety handling policies and procedures. Ability to work effectively in a team environment. c503a74bed111d38.description: About Proofpoint Proofpoint is seeking a Business Development Representative (Lead Generation) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on generating high-quality sales pipeline for the Enterprise Sales team in KSA. Role Overview The Business Development Representative will be responsible for driving lead generation efforts for enterprise accounts. This involves qualifying and developing leads, gathering account intelligence, and converting marketing-generated leads into sales opportunities. The role requires a tech-savvy individual with a strong focus on outbound lead generation. Key Responsibilities Qualify and develop inbound and outbound leads, ensuring timely follow-up on product inquiries. Gather actionable account intelligence, including information on competition, projects, intent signals, and buying teams. Convert marketing-generated leads into sales accepted opportunities. Execute targeted outreach sequences via email, phone, LinkedIn, and event follow-up. Conduct cold-calling and telephone-based prospecting campaigns. Coordinate and schedule discovery calls and demonstrations for the Enterprise Sales team. Maintain detailed and accurate activity notes within Salesforce or an equivalent CRM system. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in B2B outbound lead generation, with a preference for experience in enterprise, SaaS, cybersecurity, or other technical industries. Demonstrated success in prospecting, lead qualification, and pipeline generation. Comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders, influencers, and decision-makers across enterprise accounts. Required Skills Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, including video communication. Highly motivated, competitive, and detail-oriented. Ability to work effectively in a goal-driven environment.

c53f1f29bf8c984f.description: About DataVolt DataVolt is a global leader in sustainable and innovative data center solutions, providing infrastructure for businesses worldwide to connect, collaborate, and grow. The company's solutions prioritize security, reliability, scalability, and sustainability, supporting clients in achieving digital transformation. DataVolt operates in key locations including Riyadh, Dubai, California, Mumbai, and Tashkent, with a commitment to shaping a sustainable digital future through innovation. The Health & Safety Lead Role DataVolt is seeking a Health & Safety Lead to join its team in Tabuk, specifically covering projects in Haql and Tabuk. This full-time role involves leading the implementation of HSE requirements across projects and ensuring compliance with local regulations for construction activities. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Lead the implementation of DataVolt HSE requirements across the project. Advise, support, and ensure compliance with local regulatory and other requirements for construction projects. Provide advice and support on all HSE-related matters for construction. Identify, develop, or source required HSE training for onsite employees. Collaborate with the Project Director to ensure appointed EPC contractors implement and maintain HSE standards that meet or exceed DataVolt expectations. Ensure all accidents and incidents are reported, investigated, and recorded in a timely manner. Review work procedures to assign risk levels and assess established risk controls. Ensure High Risk Activities are effectively planned, controlled, and managed. Prepare weekly and monthly reports, review data integrity, and confirm the accuracy of weekly and monthly statistics. Carry out daily, weekly, and monthly HSE inspections for construction activities. Implement best practices and lessons learned across projects, based on previous experience, knowledge, and DataVolt requirements, where practicable. Conduct periodic HSE audits as per DataVolt requirements. Conduct weekly and monthly HSE meetings with various stakeholders and maintain records. Develop HSE initiatives and campaigns. Conduct contractor and supplier assessments where applicable. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in a relevant health and safety role, preferably within construction or data center environments. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in the Tabuk region, with responsibilities covering projects in Haql and Tabuk. The salary for this role will be discussed during the interview process.

c51060dbd377672e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البشائر المباركة للمقاولات عامة عن فني زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الفني والعلمي والمشورة في المجال الزراعي، بالإضافة إلى إجراء الاختبارات والتجارب لدعم الإنتاج الزراعي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الاختبارات على عينات مثل الخلايا النباتية أو الأنسجة الحيوانية. تحديد تأثيرات طرق الإنتاج المختلفة على النمو والعائد. اختبار جودة المنتجات الزراعية. تحديد الطفيليات والكائنات الضارة الأخرى. تفتيش المزارع ومسحها وتقييم الظروف البيئية للنباتات والحيوانات، بما في ذلك الرطوبة والحرارة والنظافة. تقديم الدعم الفني والمشورة الزراعية بخصوص تنفيذ إجراءات أو أساليب جديدة لزيادة الإنتاجية والعائد، والمساعدة في تطبيقها. تشغيل وصيانة المعدات البحثية المستخدمة لتحليل العينات، وتحديد الكائنات الحية، واختبار الجودة، أو دعم الأخصائيين الزراعيين والمزارعين. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الزراعة أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد للمبادئ والممارسات الزراعية. القدرة على إجراء الاختبارات والتجارب الميدانية والمخبرية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد المشكلات الزراعية وتقديم الحلول. القدرة على تشغيل وصيانة المعدات الزراعية والبحثية. مهارات تواصل فعالة لتقديم المشورة والدعم الفني. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الزراعة بدوام كامل في جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق شركة البشائر المباركة للمقاولات عامة. يتضمن الدور العمل الميداني في المزارع بالإضافة إلى المهام المخبرية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

c53ae89d154ee803.description: About the Role RAWAJ is seeking a Finance Director – Manufacturing & Building Materials to join its team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is based in either Jeddah or Yanbu and involves leading the finance function for a global manufacturer of building materials. The Finance Director will support operational expansion and manufacturing initiatives within the Kingdom. Role Purpose and Context The Finance Director will be responsible for driving financial strategy, business performance, governance, and operational efficiency across Saudi Arabian operations. This position acts as a strategic business partner to country leadership, providing essential financial insights to inform business decisions, investment opportunities, and sustainable growth, while ensuring robust financial controls and compliance with both local and Group requirements. Key Responsibilities Lead financial strategy and planning for KSA, ensuring alignment with GCC and Group objectives. Act as a strategic business partner to the KSA leadership team, providing financial insights and recommendations for business decisions and growth. Oversee annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, long-range financial planning, and performance management. Manage financial reporting, accounting operations, and month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes. Ensure accuracy and transparency of financial information across all KSA operations and legal entities. Establish and maintain strong internal controls, financial governance, and risk management frameworks. Ensure compliance with Saudi Arabia's statutory, tax, Zakat, VAT, and regulatory requirements. Oversee treasury, cash flow management, liquidity planning, and working capital optimization. Partner with commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, and operational teams to improve profitability, cost efficiency, and financial performance. Evaluate business expansion opportunities, capital expenditure, investments, pricing strategies, and commercial initiatives. Drive finance transformation through ERP governance, process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement. Lead, develop, and strengthen the KSA finance team, establishing clear objectives, performance KPIs, and succession plans. Manage relationships with senior leadership, external auditors, financial advisers, banks, and relevant regulatory authorities. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in finance leadership roles. Demonstrated ability to lead financial strategy and operations within a manufacturing or building materials context. Strong understanding of financial controls, compliance, and risk management. Experience with annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning. Work Environment This is a full-time position within a leading global manufacturer of building materials. The role requires collaboration with various internal teams and external stakeholders, operating in a dynamic environment focused on operational expansion and manufacturing initiatives in Saudi Arabia. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c567d8edbdfed72b.description: About Sophos Sophos is a global leader in cybersecurity, providing AI-driven platforms and expert-led services to protect over 600,000 organizations worldwide. The company's solutions integrate machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with human expertise from Sophos X-Ops, delivering advanced 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response. Sophos offers managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies, including endpoint, network, email, cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Headquartered in Oxford, *, Sophos operates through a global partner ecosystem. The Role of (Pre-) Solutions Engineer Sophos is seeking a (Pre-) Solutions Engineer to support its operations in Saudi Arabia and Pakistan. This full-time role involves managing all technical aspects of supporting distribution partners and key accounts. The Solutions Engineer will be responsible for determining technical requirements and ensuring the success of product trials and evaluations. The position requires 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Review partner opportunities, assessing their size, value, and technical complexity, and allocate appropriate systems engineering resources. Plan and prepare presentations to detail the technical elements of customer solutions. Conduct technical demonstrations for partners using specialized software and tools. Develop strong working relationships with technical staff at key partner organizations. Present at various events as a keynote speaker to promote Sophos in the region. Deliver product training sessions and webinars for partner engineers. Communicate regional technical feature requests to the product development team. Assist partners in drafting technical RFPs. Required Qualifications and Experience Experience as a technical support specialist, systems engineer, or security consultant. Solid experience with networking devices such as firewalls, proxies, VPN gateways, or UTMs. Proficiency in endpoint and gateway security, covering both threat and data protection. Demonstrated ability to present complex technical solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences. A strong technical background in networking and/or security applications. Experience working with and supporting channel partners and customers. Systems administration experience with Windows, Linux, UNIX, Novell, or macOS. Willingness to undertake substantial travel to support partners and attend international conferences and training. Work Environment Sophos supports flexible working arrangements, with many roles offered remotely or in a hybrid model. For remote positions, candidates are expected to reside in and be authorized to work in the specified location, which for this role is Saudi Arabia. Teams collaborate across various locations and time zones, utilizing technology to maintain connectivity and achieve results. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion Sophos values diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds, believing that varied thinking fosters innovative ideas. The company is committed to building an inclusive workplace where individuals can contribute, grow, and succeed. All candidates are evaluated based on job-related skills, qualifications, and experience, in adherence to equal employment opportunity principles and applicable laws. Reasonable accommodations are provided during the recruitment process upon request.

c5b95b3620d5a92a.description: About the Role Mace Group is seeking an Associate Project Director to provide project management consultancy services for a major mixed-use development in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This part-time position involves supporting the delivery of a significant new-build residential development, overseeing the project lifecycle from design through construction and handover. The role requires a minimum of 10 years of experience, with a strong focus on front-end, design, and development expertise alongside proven construction delivery capabilities. Key Responsibilities Oversee end-to-end project management and delivery of major new-build residential assets from concept design through pre-contract, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover. Establish robust project governance, controls, reporting, and decision-making processes from early design stages. Take ownership of the overall project program, with a particular focus on establishing, controlling, and maintaining the design program. Provide early project management oversight across development and design functions, ensuring development objectives translate into clear and deliverable project requirements. Coordinate with PMC design managers, architects, design consultants, specialist consultants, and the wider multidisciplinary project team to achieve design deliverables against key milestones. Challenge design progress, identify program risks, and drive consultants and stakeholders toward timely decisions and resolution. Manage the integration of design, approvals, procurement, and construction programs to maintain a clear route to delivery. Support and coordinate the project's residential sales launch strategy, ensuring critical design and delivery milestones support required commercial launch dates. Supervise the fast-track delivery of the sales center, managing interfaces between design, procurement, approvals, and construction to achieve an accelerated program, followed by the delivery of high-end residential apartment buildings. Develop and maintain the project execution plan, master program, risk register, governance structure, and project reporting requirements. Manage procurement strategy and contractor appointment activities, ensuring appropriate consideration of packaging, sequencing, program, and project risk. Transition the project effectively from pre-contract into construction and maintain continuity of project leadership throughout delivery. Manage consultants, contractors, and specialist suppliers while driving accountability against program, cost, quality, and contractual requirements. Monitor project performance, identify emerging risks, and implement recovery or mitigation measures where required. Provide clear, concise reporting to senior stakeholders on program, design, commercial matters, risks, decisions, and delivery status. Maintain stakeholder relationships and foster strong collaboration between development, design, commercial, procurement, and construction teams. Maintain strong project management discipline throughout delivery while ensuring Mace's safety, quality, and governance requirements are achieved. Qualifications and Experience Relevant project management and construction industry experience, with significant experience in senior project leadership positions. Demonstrable experience successfully delivering large-scale new-build residential developments of comparable size and complexity, ideally more than one major residential project. Strong evidence of managing residential projects across the complete lifecycle from early design/pre-contract through procurement, construction, and handover. Significant front-end and design management experience, with the ability to establish control of complex design programs and drive multidisciplinary design teams against demanding milestones. Strong understanding of residential development requirements and the relationship between development strategy, design, sales and marketing milestones, procurement, and physical delivery. Proven ability to manage and coordinate with architects, designers, engineering consultants, cost consultants, contractors, and specialist stakeholders within complex project environments. Strong program management skills with experience identifying program risk, challenging consultant performance, and implementing recovery strategies. Demonstrable procurement, contract, commercial, risk, and change-management experience. Strong client-facing and senior stakeholder-management capability, including the confidence to operate effectively within a high-profile project subject to significant executive scrutiny. Experience delivering major projects within a PMC, client-side, or development-management environment. A degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, project management, or a related discipline. Professional membership such as RICS, CIOB, APM, or equivalent would be advantageous. Previous experience delivering major residential developments in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East would be advantageous. Work Type This is a part-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Candidates who meet the outlined qualifications are encouraged to apply.

Our travel solution simplifies the process of planning and handling work-related travel. Highlights: Current funding stage: Series A FlyAkeed is supported by: PIF subsidiary Sanabil Investments, Elm, Artal Capital, Alrajhi Partners. Your creative vision and attention to detail will play a critical role in shaping the future of travel booking experiences for our customers. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product management, engineering, and marketing to align design with business goals. Maintain design consistency across all platforms by contributing to the development of design systems and style guides. This is a full-time position for an educator dedicated to inspiring and motivating students. Role Overview The Islamic Studies Teacher will be responsible for educating, inspiring, and motivating students, fostering a passion for learning, and helping them understand the importance of lifelong education. Participate in the preparation and development of courses of study, subject scope and sequence, teaching materials, teaching programs, methods of teaching and assessment, and all school plans and programs. Engage in reciprocal peer review and observation of classroom teaching practice by the subject supervisor or Head of Learning. Provide necessary information, data, plans, and documents to designated school personnel, including details regarding requisitions and arrangements related to areas of responsibility. c553d2d450896953.description: The Quality Control Engineer is responsible for inspecting, monitoring, and ensuring the quality of all finishing, interior fit-out, natural stone, and marble installation works in accordance with approved shop drawings, project specifications, material submittals, method statements, and applicable quality standards. The role requires strong technical expertise in architectural finishes, high-end interior fit-out, stone and marble fabrication and installation, ensuring that all works meet the required standards of workmanship, dimensional accuracy, alignment, levelness, joint consistency, surface finish, and overall aesthetic quality. The QC Engineer shall coordinate with site engineers, subcontractors, consultants, suppliers, and project management teams to identify quality issues, prevent defects, and ensure that all completed works comply with project requirements before handover. Key Responsibilities 1. Finishing and Interior Fit-Out Quality Control Inspect all architectural finishing and interior fit-out activities, including flooring, wall cladding, ceilings, gypsum works, painting, tiling, joinery, doors, decorative finishes, and other interior works. Ensure all executed works comply with approved shop drawings, technical specifications, material approvals, and project quality requirements. Verify dimensions, levels, alignment, verticality, surface flatness, edge details, and finishing quality. Inspect interfaces between different finishing materials to ensure proper coordination, clean transitions, and high-quality workmanship. Conduct site inspections at each stage of work to identify defects before subsequent activities proceed. 2. Stone and Marble Quality Control Perform detailed inspections of natural stone and marble materials, including marble, granite, limestone, travertine, and other decorative stone finishes. Verify material type, color, veining, texture, thickness, dimensions, finish, and overall consistency against approved samples and material submittals. Inspect stone and marble slabs, tiles, and fabricated pieces for cracks, chips, scratches, stains, discoloration, edge damage, and other visual or dimensional defects. Verify slab selection, vein matching, bookmatching, grain direction, color consistency, and layout patterns in accordance with approved drawings and samples. Inspect stone fabrication, cutting, edge profiling, mitre joints, corner details, openings, cut-outs, and polishing quality. Monitor stone and marble installation, ensuring correct setting-out, alignment, levelness, joint width, lippage control, fixing systems, adhesive application, and anchoring methods. Verify substrate preparation, waterproofing where applicable, backing supports, mechanical fixing systems, and installation methods according to approved details and manufacturer recommendations. Inspect grouting, joint filling, sealant application, staining protection, cleaning, polishing, and final finishing. Ensure proper handling, transportation, storage, and protection of stone and marble materials to prevent damage before and after installation. Identify and report unacceptable workmanship, material defects, and installation deviations, and ensure corrective actions are completed. 3. Inspection and Quality Documentation Prepare and submit Inspection Requests (IRs/WIRs) and coordinate inspections with the consultant and client representatives. Review approved shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and project specifications before work execution. Maintain inspection records, checklists, material inspection reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and quality documentation. Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for defective or non-compliant works and follow up on corrective and preventive actions. Verify that corrective works have been completed satisfactorily before requesting reinspection. Maintain photographic records of site inspections, defects, corrective actions, and completed works. Support the preparation of snag lists, de-snagging inspections, and final handover documentation. 4. Site Coordination and Quality Assurance Coordinate with site engineers, finishing engineers, subcontractors, stone suppliers, fabrication workshops, consultants, and project management teams. Review and inspect mock-ups and sample installations before approving or recommending approval for mass production and installation. Monitor workmanship during execution and provide technical guidance to prevent recurring quality defects. Ensure materials and workmanship are consistent with approved samples, design intent, project specifications, and client expectations. Participate in quality meetings, progress inspections, and technical coordination meetings. Ensure completed works are properly protected against damage caused by subsequent construction activities. Monitor compliance with approved quality procedures, relevant standards, and project-specific requirements. 5. Final Inspection and Handover Conduct final quality inspections of completed finishing, fit-out, stone, and marble works. Verify uniformity of finishes, joint consistency, alignment, surface condition, cleanliness, and overall visual appearance. Identify and document defects, incomplete works, and deviations from approved requirements. Follow up on snagging and de-snagging activities until all quality issues are resolved. Ensure proper cleaning, sealing, polishing, protection, and maintenance requirements are completed before handover. Assist in compiling quality records and handover documents. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in construction quality control, preferably in finishing, interior fit-out, and high-end architectural projects. Strong hands-on experience in natural stone and marble fabrication, installation, inspection, and finishing. Practical knowledge of marble and stone flooring, wall cladding, countertops, staircases, vanity tops, decorative stone features, and custom stonework. Good understanding of architectural drawings, shop drawings, material specifications, method statements, and installation details. Experience in preparing inspection requests, quality checklists, NCRs, and inspection reports. Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management principles and project-specific QA/QC procedures. Proficiency in reading construction drawings and using AutoCAD and Microsoft Office is preferred. Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and reporting skills. A
